item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00109","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C24","C10","C07"],"selected_candidate_label":"C24","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C24 is a highly persuasive drafting template. Issued only three days earlier, it uses nearly identical language and the same operative machinery: specified district land offices are discontinued; their business and necessary archives are transferred and consolidated in another land office at a named location; and the change takes effect at the close of business on a specified date. The child is essentially a shorter geographic adaptation of C24. C10 and C07 share only an effective-date structure and do not approach this material correspondence.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The district land offices at Blackfoot and Coeur d'Alene, Idaho, shall be discontinued","parent_excerpt":"The district land offices at The Dalles, Lakeview, and Roseburg, Oregon, shall be discontinued","explanation":"Distinctive parallel opening provision, with only the affected offices and state changed."},{"child_excerpt":"the business and necessary archives of those offices shall be transferred to and consolidated in a new district land office which shall be established and maintained at Boise, Idaho","parent_excerpt":"the business and necessary archives of those offices shall be transferred to and consolidated in a district land office which shall be established and maintained at Portland, Oregon","explanation":"Nearly verbatim administrative mechanism for transferring and consolidating office business and archives at a newly maintained destination office."},{"child_excerpt":"This order shall become effective at the close of business on August 13, 1948.","parent_excerpt":"This order shall become effective at the close of business on July 30, 1948.","explanation":"Identical effective-date clause apart from the date."}]}
